independentProbe.claimBoundary: Synthetic source-derived data consistency, no runtime invocation or authority.

reviewDecision.methodology: Consumed frozen submitted six paths, 88/88 pre-edit receipt, 25/25 focused proof, actual example result, retained failed/candidate/final gate logs and detached hash/time logs. Read the complete bounded profile, helper, tests, example, guide and return; verified all 33 worker source pins before closure and original S2-R1 submitted/accepted pins. Root independently executed source-derived API/CLI controls without importing worker tests, completed the defect-class sweep before one consolidated repair, then reran only the affected new focused suite and oracle. EVALUATE_RETURNED_EVIDENCE_NOT_RECREATE_IMPLEMENTATION; no old suite or broad corpus replay.
reviewDecision.findings: Four Local semantic repair groups: (1) type-guard actor normalization and strict cross-clock parsing preserve malformed-input/sibling diagnostics, (2) independence also applies to assigned PENDING reviewers, (3) ACCEPTED_UNREPAIRED is checked across technical dispositions, (4) offset minutes above59 are rejected rather than normalized. The complete before-repair oracle had121/129 PASS with eight counterexamples; the repaired helper has129/129 PASS and five new focused regressions give30/30 PASS. The actual S2-R1 retrospective consumer/source pins are correct and unchanged. Requested historical Luna/xhigh remains distinct from this native Luna/max assignment.
reviewDecision.risk: Original worker implementation required Local semantic repair despite25/25 worker tests and70/70 structural gate. Original seven CLI subtest failures are self-reported because the first terminal log was not retained; do not label that run hash-proven. Retained gate failures and exact frozen final proof are consumed. Root first oracle had one shared-object fixture defect affecting two cases plus five over-specific code expectations; these were corrected against the locked profile and all initial results retained separately, not attributed to Luna. Source authentication, omitted history, actor authenticity, observed runtime identity, tokens/quota/bill, complete R3/runtime selection and comparative quality remain unproved.
reviewDecision.closeability: After full bounded source audit, one Local consolidated repair and exact affected evidence, no semantic blocker remains under the locked optional profile. New helper/tests, usable retrospective consumer/guide and distinct Local acceptance are present. No worker redispatch, extra provider call or independent benchmark is needed; private material/actual-SHA continuity and final gate receipts follow. S5/Expense/PLL/scoring/Gateway/public/provider/deploy/P11 remain parked.
reviewDecision.closureDiagnostic: Root closure only: correct a63-character raw-profile hash typo in the worker return, append an attributed Local review addendum, accept the guide, refresh active SCEC test/closed-order pins, close the order and update its exact authority hash/projections. Preserve worker JSON/example and submitted originals. Initial root oracle corrections and all admission/continuity corrections remain separately attributed. Final committed-range receipts are produced only after actual commits; split material checks are not promoted to historical committed-target proof if later continuity changed the projections. First material-helper preflight failed; opaque child output required one explicit diagnostic rerun, which found two metadata classes. Source read-ahead corrected confirmatory wording and truthful scoped zero-map/PARTIAL accounting without changing code or importing a corpus. A cached old PASS receipt was initially copied during diagnostic lookup; it is not failure proof. One read-only Windows rg path-glob lookup failed and was corrected to the exact file.
